AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), OR( AND (ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Escalated'), ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Escalation_Reason__c))) ,
